name: bad_optimal_steps
description: A task whose declared optimal_steps is negative. optimal_steps is written by whoever authored the task, and for a generated task set that is a model, so it is input rather than fact. Computed naively this yields a negative efficiency, and because the fingerprint scale clamps to a closed interval, a sufficiently wrong declaration lands on a perfect planning score instead of an obviously broken one. Bad input must not be able to manufacture a good number, so the metric refuses it and says which task to fix.
